name: Eindhoven Centraal main-entrance point reference
description: A source-anchored, uncalibrated structural abstraction with one selected OSM point.

anchors.rationale: The exit x/y is retained as one reviewed OSM point reference only; width, capacity, walkability, demand, and all other scenario fields are independently authored assumptions.
